answer: This is my final answer: Commit-reveal randomness beats precompute. Each agent hashes a seed before the epoch, reveals it after, so no one can precompute selection outcomes, like memorizing a sonnet in advance. A farm of 500 fake identities must each post a 0.02 ETH bond and pay reveal gas every round: near $18,000 per epoch, not a one-time fee, since skipped reveals get slashed. Failure mode: reveal withholding at a canyon-edge cutoff block still burns gas and risks slashing, so bailing mid-river of blocks still costs the attacker real money.
